searchText: Can't we just use an arbitrary byte to create domain separation? ah fair the main criteria is how large the trusted setup needs to be, e.g. we can do something smaller for DAS and i think Verkle trees -- assuming we can do a ceremony w/ say 2^15 elements then that setup can be re-used in each of the applications we care about; and it would make sense to have domain separation like <@!570268431522201601> says
